content.title: Where to watch Lakers vs. Rockets NBA Playoffs game 1 for free today
content.text: Los Angeles Lakers forward LeBron James, right, drives by Cleveland Cavaliers guard James Harden during the first half of an NBA basketball game Tuesday, March 31, 2026, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Mark J. Terrill)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comThe Los Angeles Lakers play against the Houston Rockets in game 1 of their NBA Playoff series today. The game is scheduled to begin at 7:30 p.m. CT on ABC.Can you use DIRECTV and Fubo TV to watch Lakers vs. Rockets for free today?DIRECTV and Fubo TV offer five-day free trials to new users, and they can both broadcast ABC. With this in mind, basketball fans can catch game 1 of the series for free today. Is DIRECTV or Fubo TV better to watch the NBA Playoffs this year?Notably, DIRECTV is the better streaming service to watch the rest of the NBA Playoffs. It can broadcast the upcoming playoff games on NBC, while Fubo TV is unable to broadcast any NBC channels. In order to make the first month of service more affordable, DIRECTV offers a $35 discount. The promotion drops the first-month subscription price to $69.99. Is Sling an affordable alternative to watch Lakers vs. Rockets game 1 today?Sling is the most affordable streaming service, as it offers the cheapest monthly subscription. It also offers a day pass for just $4.99, which will help basketball fans watch the playoff game today.
